rows.grounds: long compound naming putrajivaka, padma-aksha, rudraksha, and sphatika as sources of birth; accusative feminine singular adjective form

items.question: From which substances is the consecrated form said to arise?
premises: The substances include putrajivaka and sphatika.
items.inference: The verse identifies material origins of the consecrated form.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the form is not explicit in this unit.
items.plain_english: Born from putrajivaka, padma-aksha, rudraksha, and sphatika.
